description: Ex-Thunderbolts Hunter F.56A displayed at AFS Chabua in the team's blue scheme, left there after the airframe was found overstressed after a display; serial not recorded. Mosmap 27.473228 95.121839. Source warbirds.in (Sanjay Simha photo).
MiG-21FL C610 (No.30 Sqn 2001) recorded by bharat-rakshak as the gate display at AFS Chabua. Not independently photographed here.
